name: Darien Nature Center Summer Camp
description_short: Half-day nature day camp at Darien Nature Center and Cherry Lawn Park, Monday to Friday from 9:30 AM to 2:00 PM, with a different theme each week. Campers ages 3–6 are in "Our Living Planet" and ages 7–10 are in "Eco Explorers."
activities: evening campfire and night hike (Eco Explorers Week 2)
refund_policy_summary: If you cancel by May 1, 2026, you get a 50% refund. There are no refunds after May 1, and no credits for withdrawals. Card processing fees are never refunded. Payments are not refunded if camp temporarily closes for reasons beyond the center's control.

sessions.name: Week 2: In The Garden (ages 3-6) / Out in the Wild (ages 7-10), no camp July 3
Week 3: Biomes (ages 3-6) / Sunshine and Soil: Growing Food (ages 7-10)
Week 4: Rocks and Fossils (ages 3-6) / Nature Art (ages 7-10)
Week 5: Our Blue Planet (ages 3-6) / Geology Rocks (ages 7-10)
Week 7: Rewild the World (ages 3-6) / Animal Kingdom (ages 7-10)

warnings: This page covers the 2026 season, which ended on August 7, 2026. As of today (2026-10-13), no 2027 dates, prices or registration details are posted. Treat all values as last year's.

The weekly prices are full price. Early-bird prices were $660 a week, or $528 for the short Week 2. In 2026, early-bird registration ran January 14 - February 6, current families and members could register February 16 - March 9, and public registration opened March 10.

Each week runs two groups at the same time: 'Our Living Planet' for ages 3-6 (must be 3 by January 1, 2026) and 'Eco Explorers' for ages 7-10 (must be 7 by June 22, 2026). Both groups have the same prices. Each session entry here covers both age groups.
Card payments carry processing fees, which families pay and which are not refundable.
The scholarship depends on available funds and was described as going to 'a qualifying family', so it may be very limited.
The page showed an 'Apply for the Waitlist' button, so 2026 weeks may have been full. Availability is recorded as unknown.
